sources.note: Primary World/Iceborne-era records for weaknesses, locations and rewards; the API does not expose World hitzones in this endpoint.
World expedition health profiles by rank and locale; stored as reference profiles instead of being mislabeled as a universal base health.
World/Iceborne roster supplement used for records absent from the primary endpoint.
Game-extracted Rise data and base health/part thresholds.
Wilds weaknesses, rewards and part multipliers.
Published Wilds monster size ranges used as explicit lower/upper crown bounds; exact Silver thresholds are not published.
MHGU pages provide rank-specific quest health, hitzones A/B, status thresholds, break data and Low/High/G Rank reward tables.
Fallback for MHGU records without a Kiranico table; data is decoded from game resources and the upstream project documents the one missing Ahtal-Neset record.
High-resolution game render references by title and monster; image source attribution is retained by the provider.
PNG render references selected by exact game/variant filename; MHGU may also use an explicitly marked cross-game render from MHGen/MH4U/MHFU/MH3U when no MHGU file exists.
Alternative source for ecology, useful information and habitat text when the structured dataset lacks it.
Alternative per-game bestiary descriptions, species, size, elements, ailments and weaknesses used only as field-level fallback.
Local build-time Portuguese translations are stored separately from source text; the catalog does not silently fall back to English in the UI.

entries.name: Aptonoth
entries.description: Docile herbivores that graze in packs. Their meat is considered a delicacy and is rich in nutrients. If one member of the herd is attacked, the rest will flee immediately.
entries.descriptionPt: Herbívoros que costumam ser alvo de muitos predadores. Geralmente fogem em rebanhos.

entries.name: Jagras
entries.description: Members of the Great Jagras pack, these smaller monsters will flee upon seeing one of their own perish. They're also known for ambushing larger monsters at a moment's notice.
entries.descriptionPt: Monstros territoriais que emboscam outros monstros em grupo quando têm a chance.

entries.name: Mernos
entries.description: Wingdrakes that feast on scatternuts. The flock will travel great distances when startled, making them an invaluable mode of transportation for clever hunters.
entries.descriptionPt: Dracoaladas que viajam em bandos gigantescos. Caçadores astutos podem usá-las como transporte.

entries.name: Vespoid
entries.description: Insects that paralyze their targets with their long stingers. They break easily, so attack them with poison or slinger ammo if you want to carve them.

ailments.name: Paralysis
ailments.description: Paralysis renders the hunter or monster immobilized and susceptible to increased damage for the duration. Hunters can unparalyzed if they are hit.

entries.descriptionPt: Os ferrões contêm agente paralisante e as partes servem para munição de atiradeira e armas venenosas.

entries.name: Mosswine
entries.description: Mosswine are known for their excellent sense of smell, and are often found foraging for fungi. If you're hunting for mushrooms, follow the Mosswine to the motherlode.
entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro pequeno que usa seu olfato aguçado para rastrear sua comida favorita: cogumelos.

entries.name: Apceros
entries.description: Herbivores that inhabit the Wildspire Waste. They've developed particularly hard hide to ward off attackers, and are known to gather in groups to defend themselves.
entries.descriptionPt: Um herbívoro que desenvolveu uma carapaça dura para proteger-se de atacantes em potencial.

entries.name: Kestodon
entries.description: Female Kestodon will alert the pack of danger, while the males will violently charge would-be threats. Their rushing charges can be blocked, however, leaving them open to attacks.
entries.descriptionPt: Fêmeas alertam o rebanho enquanto os machos durões atacam sem discriminação.

entries.name: Noios
entries.description: Wingdrakes that produce a sound similar to screamer pods when startled. Use meat to get their attention, and then hunt them for materials, or use them for transportation.
entries.descriptionPt: Dracoaladas que produzem um som quelembra explosões quando alarmados por cápsulas gritantes.

entries.name: Gajau
entries.description: Vicious piscine that form groups to defend their territory from intruders. Be sure not to venture too closely to their habitat!
entries.descriptionPt: Peixe gigante que patrulha as águas, feroz como um monstro grande.

entries.name: Kelbi
entries.description: Small herbivores known for their gentle demeanor and the medicinal properties of their horns. Those wishing to harvest a horn should aim for the head when attacking them.
entries.descriptionPt: Herbívoros dóceis. Seus chifres são valiosos para fins medicinais.

entries.name: Raphinos
entries.description: Wingdrakes inhabiting the Coral Highlands. They group up to steal the eggs of other animals, but this in turn exposes them to the attention of larger, more vicious predators.
entries.descriptionPt: Serpes que habitam os Planaltos Coralinos. Elas se fartam com ovos em grandes bandos.

entries.name: Shamos
entries.description: Small nocturnal monsters. They're particularly vulnerable to Tzitzi-Ya-Ku's blinding flash, but have been known to gang up on enemies.
entries.descriptionPt: Pequenos monstros noturnos que patrulham agressivamente seu território.

entries.name: Girros
entries.description: Monsters known to attack in packs, using the deadly vapor of the Rotten Vale to their advantage. They're known for crippling targets with paralyzing fangs.

ailments.name: Paralysis
ailments.description: Paralysis renders the hunter or monster immobilized and susceptible to increased damage for the duration. Hunters can unparalyzed if they are hit.

entries.descriptionPt: Monstros em bando que atacam com presas paralisantes.

entries.name: Hornetaur
entries.description: Small insects that are found primarily on land. They're highly territorial and will attack anything that approaches them. Gather their materials by attacking them with the slinger.
entries.descriptionPt: Insetos que habitam diversas terras. Seus cascos grossos os protegem contra ataques.

entries.name: Gastodon
entries.description: Pack monsters that inhabit the Elder's Recess. They are easily angered by intruders, and will charge at monsters twice their size.
entries.descriptionPt: Monstros em bando que se irritam facilmente com intrusos e atacam monstros com o dobro do tamanho.

entries.name: Barnos
entries.description: Fervid wingdrakes that have flourished under harsh living conditions. They target intruders with a unique acidic agent, and then attack as a swarm.

ailments.name: Defense Down
ailments.description: Some monsters may inflict a status that lowers a hunter's defense. Lasts for a certain period of time but can also be cured with defense-increasing items.

items.name: Armorskin
items.description: Boosts your defense by turning your skin as hard as rock.

items.name: Mega Armorskin
items.description: Boosts your defense even more than a regular armorskin.

entries.descriptionPt: Dracoaladas que de alguma forma sobrevivem em condições adversas. Cospem um ácido mortal.

entries.name: Great Jagras
entries.description: The pack leader of the Jagras. When hungry, Great Jagras are known to attack monsters even stronger than themselves. It balloons to unbelievable proportions after swallowing prey.

ecology.characteristics: The pack leader of the Jagras. When hungry, Great Jagras are known to attack monsters even stronger than themselves. It balloons to unbelievable proportions after swallowing prey.
ecology.usefulInfo: Even after a giant meal, a Great Jagras can use its expanded stomach to attack unsuspecting hunters. Aim for its belly to force it to vomit out its prey and significantly weaken it.

entries.descriptionPt: O alfa voraz dos Jagras, sempre caçando a próxima refeição.

ecologyPt.characteristics: O líder dos Jagras. Quando famintos, Grandes Jagras são conhecidos por atacar monstros ainda mais fortes do que eles mesmos. Ele balões para proporções inacreditáveis depois de engolir presas.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Mesmo depois de uma refeição gigante, um Grande Jagras pode usar seu estômago expandido para atacar caçadores insuspeitos. Apontar para sua barriga para forçá-lo a vomitar sua presa e enfraquecê-la significativamente.

entries.name: Kulu-Ya-Ku
entries.description: An odd bird wyvern that has developed limbs capable of carrying weapons. It's been spotted stealing eggs from nests found in the Ancient Forest and Wildspire Waste.

ecology.characteristics: An odd bird wyvern that has developed limbs capable of carrying weapons. It's been spotted stealing eggs from nests found in the Ancient Forest and Wildspire Waste.
ecology.usefulInfo: Kulu-Ya-Ku can use small boulders to shield itself or smash against its enemies. Force it to drop whatever it's holding by using your slinger. You can also frighten it by luring once of its natural enemies.

entries.descriptionPt: Um serpássaro que utiliza os membros dianteiros desenvolvidos para atacar com todo tipo de instrumento.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma administração de aves estranha que desenvolveu membros capazes de transportar armas. Foi visto a roubar ovos de ninhos encontrados na Floresta Antiga e nos Resíduos de Wildspire.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Kulu-Ya-Ku pode usar pequenos pedregulhos para se proteger ou esmagar contra seus inimigos. Força-o a largar o que quer que esteja a aguentar usando o seu slinger. Você também pode assustá-lo por atrair uma vez de seus inimigos naturais.

entries.name: Pukei-Pukei
entries.description: A bird wyvern known to possess poisonous toxins in its body. It's been spotted storing scatternuts in its mouth or tail, coating them with poison and spitting them out at threats.

ecology.characteristics: A bird wyvern known to possess poisonous toxins in its body. It's been spotted storing scatternuts in its mouth or tail, coating them with poison and spitting them out at threats.
ecology.usefulInfo: Observational reports state that Pukei-Pukei will bully weaker monsters but cower before bigger, stronger monsters. It's prone to retreating at the first sign of danger, so use that to your advantage.

ailments.name: Poison
ailments.description: Poison slowly drains the target's health.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: A cure for poison.

items.name: Herbal Medicine
items.description: Removes all traces of poison and restores a slight amount of health.

ailments.name: Stun
ailments.description: Stun renders the target inactive, and sometimes causes them to fall over.

healthProfiles.rank: ★1 Fungal Flexin' in the Ancient Forest

entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro vil que carrega veneno em seus órgãos vitais e o mistura com a flora para cuspi-lo nos alvos.

healthProfiles.rank: ★1 Fungal Flexin' in the Ancient Forest

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um wyvern de pássaro conhecido por possuir toxinas venenosas em seu corpo. Foi visto a armazenar descascados na boca ou na cauda, a cobri-los com veneno e cuspir-los em ameaças.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Relatórios observacionais afirmam que Pukei-Pukei vai intimidar monstros mais fracos, mas cower antes monstros maiores e mais fortes. É propenso a recuar no primeiro sinal de perigo, então use isso para sua vantagem.

entries.name: Barroth
entries.description: Barroth seek out ants, their favorite snack, and mark their territory with mud. They attack potential rivals with their devastating charging attack.

ecology.characteristics: Barroth seek out ants, their favorite snack, and mark their territory with mud. They attack potential rivals with their devastating charging attack.
ecology.usefulInfo: While it uses hardened mud as armor, Barroth can also fling it off its body as an attack. Use water element weapons or your slinger to gradually knock off its mud.

ailments.name: Waterblight
ailments.description: Waterblight slows down stamina recovery rate.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

ailments.name: Muddy
ailments.description: A status effect inflicted when mud thrown by a monster covers the Hunter and makes movement more difficult. Slows all actions until the hunter leaves the mud.

entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro que marca território com lama enquanto procura seu lanche favorito: formigas.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Barroth procurar formigas, seu lanche favorito, e marcar seu território com lama. Eles atacam potenciais rivais com seu ataque devastador de carga.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Enquanto ele usa lama endurecida como armadura, Barroth também pode tirá-lo de seu corpo como um ataque. Use armas de elementos de água ou seu slinger para gradualmente derrubar sua lama.

entries.name: Jyuratodus
entries.description: A large piscine wyvern that inhabits the swamps of the Wildspire Waste. It uses mud to capture prey, and it's known to battle Barroth over territory.

ecology.characteristics: A large piscine wyvern that inhabits the swamps of the Wildspire Waste. It uses mud to capture prey, and it's known to battle Barroth over territory.
ecology.usefulInfo: It's nearly impossible to fight a Jyuratodus in its swampy home. Coerce it to land, and then use water element weapons or your slinger to slowly chip away its hardened mug armor.

ailments.name: Waterblight
ailments.description: Waterblight slows down stamina recovery rate.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

ailments.name: Muddy
ailments.description: A status effect inflicted when mud thrown by a monster covers the Hunter and makes movement more difficult. Slows all actions until the hunter leaves the mud.

entries.descriptionPt: Uma hidroserpe que usa a lama ao redor não apenas como armadura, mas também como arma.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma grande wyvern de piscine que habita os pântanos do Ermo Selvático. Usa lama para capturar presas, e é conhecido por combater Barroth sobre território.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: É quase impossível lutar contra um Jyuratodus na sua casa pantanosa. Coerça-o para pousar e, em seguida, use armas de elemento de água ou o seu slinger para lentamente cortar sua armadura de caneca endurecida.

entries.name: Tobi-Kadachi
entries.description: A fanged wyvern that flies among the trees of the Ancient Forest. Its penchant to brush against the ground and the trees as it moves around builds up static electricity within its fur.

ecology.characteristics: A fanged wyvern that flies among the trees of the Ancient Forest. Its penchant to brush against the ground and the trees as it moves around builds up static electricity within its fur.
ecology.usefulInfo: Use the target camera to avoid getting ambushed from behind as it moves from tree to tree. The key to defeating this monster is to immobilize it and prevent it from reaching a charged state.

ailments.name: Thunderblight
ailments.description: Thunderblight increases the chance of being stunned.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Reside nas partes mais altas da Floresta Ancestral. Armazena eletricidade estática no pelo.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma wyvern com presas que voa entre as árvores da Floresta Antiga. Seu penchant para escovar contra o chão e as árvores enquanto se move em torno constrói eletricidade estática dentro de sua pele.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Use a câmera de destino para evitar ser emboscada por trás enquanto se move da árvore para a árvore. A chave para derrotar este monstro é imobilizá-lo e impedi-lo de alcançar um estado carregado.

entries.name: Anjanath
entries.description: The Anjanath patrols the Ancient Forest, looking for its favorite meal, Aptonoth. This belligerent monster will attack anything without hesitation.

ecology.characteristics: The Anjanath patrols the Ancient Forest, looking for its favorite meal, Aptonoth. This belligerent monster will attack anything without hesitation.
ecology.usefulInfo: Anjanath spits fiery blasts from its mouth utilizing a unique organ in its throat. Focusing attacks on its throat will make battling it much easier.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

healthProfiles.rank: ★1 Fungal Flexin' in the Ancient Forest

entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro hostil que lutará contra qualquer coisa. Cuidado com as mordidas e os chutes perigosos.

healthProfiles.rank: ★1 Fungal Flexin' in the Ancient Forest

ecologyPt.characteristics: O Anjanath patrulha a Floresta Antiga, procurando sua refeição favorita, Aptonoth. Este monstro beligerante atacará qualquer coisa sem hesitação.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Anjanath lança explosões de fogo de sua boca utilizando um órgão único em sua garganta. Concentrar ataques em sua garganta fará battling muito mais fácil.

entries.name: Azure Rathalos
entries.description: An azure-colored subspecies of Rathalos. More mobile than their standard cousins, they locate prey from the air and quickly swoop in for the kill.

ecology.characteristics: An azure-colored subspecies of Rathalos. More mobile than their standard cousins, they locate prey from the air and quickly swoop in for the kill.
ecology.usefulInfo: Counter its airborne onslaught by observing its flight patterns and finding the right moment to knock it out of the sky. Once grounded, it loses its ability to perform consecutive attacks, making the fight much easier.

entries.descriptionPt: Um Rathalos coberto de escamas lazúli. Prefere ataques aéreos em suas presas.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma subespécie azure-colorida de Rathalos. Mais móveis do que seus primos padrão, eles localizam presas do ar e rapidamente entram para a matança.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Conte com seu ataque aéreo observando seus padrões de voo e encontrando o momento certo para tirá-lo do céu. Uma vez aterrado, perde sua capacidade de realizar ataques consecutivos, tornando a luta muito mais fácil.

entries.name: Bazelgeuse
entries.description: A nefarious flying wyvern that travels the New World in search of prey. It scatters explosive scales over a wide area to prey on whatever gets caught in the blast.

ecology.characteristics: A nefarious flying wyvern that travels the New World in search of prey. It scatters explosive scales over a wide area to prey on whatever gets caught in the blast.
ecology.usefulInfo: The scales that Bazelgeuse scatters explode with tremendous force, making them extremely deadly. Focus on its legs to knock it down, and then knock out its scale-generating organs.

ailments.name: Blastblight
ailments.description: Blastblight will cause a damaging explosion after a certain amount of time has passed, or upon sustaining a heavy impact.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro nefasto que patrulha todo o continente em busca de presas. Dispersa escamas explosivas.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um governo voador nefasto que viaja o Novo Mundo em busca de presas. Espalha escalas explosivas sobre uma área ampla para presas em tudo o que é apanhado na explosão.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: As escalas que Bazelgeuse espalha explodem com força tremenda, tornando-os extremamente mortais. Concentre-se em suas pernas para derrubar e, em seguida, derrubar seus órgãos geradores de escala.

entries.name: Behemoth
entries.description: A powerful beast from another world. Its large horns and muscular frame defy nature. Unique strategies are required to battle it.

ecology.characteristics: A powerful beast from another world. Its large horns and muscular frame defy nature. Unique strategies are required to battle it.
ecology.usefulInfo: Cannot be fought alone; a combination of a healer, attacker, and an instigator are required. When Ecliptic Meteor is summoned, take cover behind a fallen Comet or face your fate.

ailments.name: Bleeding
ailments.description: Bleeding causes damage when performing certain actions, such as running, dodging, or attacking.

items.name: Well-done Steak
items.description: Provides a moderate boost to your stamina and keeps it at max for a longer period. Meat done right!

items.name: Astera Jerky
items.description: Juicy, dried meat made by Astera's chef. Boosts natural healing and cures bleeding.

items.name: Sushifish Scale
items.description: A scale from a Sushifish. Eat to restore a small amount of health. Also works to treat bleeding.

items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Fera de outro mundo. Tem uma estrutura musculosa e dois chifres gigantes.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma besta poderosa de outro mundo. Seus chifres grandes e natureza defy quadro muscular. Estratégias únicas são necessárias para combatê-lo.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Não pode ser combatido sozinho; uma combinação de um curador, atacante e um instigador são necessários. Quando o Meteor Eclíptico é convocado, cubra atrás de um Cometa caído ou encare seu destino.

entries.name: Deviljho
entries.description: A monster that must feed constantly and will devour anything in its path, even feeding on the largest of monsters with its massive jowls.

ecology.characteristics: Due to its enhanced metabolism, Deviljho must constantly seek out prey. It is extremely violent, and known to snatch up large monsters in its powerful maw and flail them around.
ecology.usefulInfo: When enraged, Deviljho's swollen muscles glow a hellish red. It will start spewing a sweeping dragon element attack, so watch your distance. Deviljho stays on the attack even when wounded, but don't give up; keep fighting and you'll come out on top.

ailments.name: Dragonblight
ailments.description: Dragonblight causes your weapon's elemental properties are nullified.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

ailments.name: Defense Down
ailments.description: Some monsters may inflict a status that lowers a hunter's defense. Lasts for a certain period of time but can also be cured with defense-increasing items.

items.name: Armorskin
items.description: Boosts your defense by turning your skin as hard as rock.

items.name: Mega Armorskin
items.description: Boosts your defense even more than a regular armorskin.

entries.descriptionPt: Serpe voraz, forte e cruel. Depois de subjugar um monstro, pode facilmente balançá-lo de um lado a outro.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Devido ao seu metabolismo aprimorado, Deviljho deve constantemente procurar presa. É extremamente violento, e conhecido por pegar grandes monstros em sua poderosa maw e flail-los ao redor.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Quando enfurecido, os músculos inchados do Diabo brilham um vermelho infernal. Ele vai começar a espiar um ataque de elemento dragão, então observe sua distância. Deviljho fica no ataque mesmo quando ferido, mas não desista; continue lutando e você vai sair em cima.

entries.name: Diablos
entries.description:
The apex monster of the Wildspire Waste.
A menacing, territorial beast that lurks underground.
Loud noises will cause it to lunge out of the sand in search of prey.

ecology.characteristics: The apex monster of the Wildspire Waste. A menacing, territorial beast that lurks underground. Loud noises will cause it to lunge out of the sand in search of prey.
ecology.usefulInfo: Diablos can be forcibly brought to the surface by using loud sounds. And its charging attack, while devastatingly powerful, can be baited into colliding with a wildspire, momentarily getting the Diablos stuck.

ailments.name: Stun
ailments.description: Stun renders the target inactive, and sometimes causes them to fall over.

entries.descriptionPt: O soberano do Ermo Selvagulha. Extremamente territorial, com uma tendência por investidas repentinas.

ecologyPt.characteristics: O monstro ápice do Ermo Selvático. Uma besta ameaçadora e territorial que se esconde no subsolo. Ruídos altos farão com que ele pule da areia em busca de presa.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Diablos pode ser forçosamente trazido à superfície usando sons altos. E seu ataque de carga, enquanto devastadormente poderoso, pode ser iscado em colidir com um wildspire, momentaneamente ficando o Diablos preso.

entries.name: Black Diablos
entries.description: These black-shelled Diablos are actually female Diablos in heat. The color signals their aggressiveness and heightened hostility to other creatures in their habitat.

ecology.characteristics: These black-shelled Diablos are actually female Diablos in heat. The color signals their aggressiveness and heightened hostility to other creature in their habitat.
ecology.usefulInfo: Diablos are much more aggressive against intruders when in heat, and are known to attack enemies in retreat. Do not let your guard down even if you think you've established a safe distance from these monsters.

entries.descriptionPt: Na época do acasalamento, as escamas da Diablos ficam negras. Conhecidas como as mães do Ermo Selvagulha.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Estes Diablos de claque preto são realmente fêmea Diablos em calor. A cor indica sua agressividade e maior hostilidade a outra criatura em seu habitat.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Diablos são muito mais agressivos contra intrusos quando em calor, e são conhecidos por atacar inimigos em retirada. Não deixe o seu guarda para baixo mesmo que você acha que estabeleceu uma distância segura destes monstros.

entries.name: Dodogama
entries.description: A monster that devours rock as its primary diet. The Crystals it devours mix with its saliva to produce explosive minerals that it can spit at its enemies.

ecology.characteristics: A monster that devours rocks as its primary diet. The crystals it devours mix with its saliva to produce explosive minerals that it can spit at its enemies.
ecology.usefulInfo: Dodogama collects explosive minerals in its mouth, but doing so weakens its massive jaw. Causing the minerals detonate while they're still in Dodogama's mouth will create a great opening for an attack.

ailments.name: Blastblight
ailments.description: Blastblight will cause a damaging explosion after a certain amount of time has passed, or upon sustaining a heavy impact.

entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro obeso que devora minerais. Sua saliva age como um catalisador explosivo.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um monstro que devora rochas como sua dieta primária. Os cristais que devora misturam-se com sua saliva para produzir minerais explosivos que pode cuspir em seus inimigos.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Dodogama coleta minerais explosivos em sua boca, mas fazê-lo enfraquece sua mandíbula maciça. Tomar os minerais detonar enquanto ainda estão na boca do Dodogama vai criar uma grande abertura para um ataque.

entries.name: Great Girros
entries.description:
A monster that scavenges for meals dropped from the Coral Highlands.
It acts as the alpha leader of a Girros pack, and sports giant fangs that paralyze its prey.

ecology.characteristics: A monster that scavenges for meals dropped from the Coral Highlands. It acts as the alpha leader of a Girros pack, and sports giant fangs that paralyze its prey.
ecology.usefulInfo: Taking down lesser Girros will make the rest of the pack scatter, and should be a top priority. Breaking the fangs of a Great Girros will make its paralyzing agent much weaker.

ailments.name: Paralysis
ailments.description: Paralysis renders the hunter or monster immobilized and susceptible to increased damage for the duration. Hunters can unparalyzed if they are hit.

entries.descriptionPt: Viaja com outros Girros menores. Usa suas presas paralisantes para capturar a presa.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um monstro que mexe para as refeições caiu das Planalto Coralino. Ele atua como o líder alfa de um pacote Girros, e ostenta presas gigantes que paralisam sua presa.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Reduzir menos Girros fará o resto do pacote de dispersão, e deve ser uma prioridade máxima. Quebrar as presas de um Grande Girros fará seu agente paralisante muito mais fraco.

entries.name: Kirin
entries.description:
Kirin are so rarely sighted that little is known of their ecology. It's been said they envelop themselves in pure electricity when they are provoked.
The lightning a Kirin cloaks itself with has been confirmed to toughen its skin. The key to hunting a Kirin lies in staggering it, using Elderseal weapons, and protecting yourself from and avoiding its lightning attacks.

ecology.characteristics: Kirin are so rarely sighted that little is known of their ecology. It's been said they envelop themselves in pure electricity when they are provoked.
ecology.usefulInfo: The lightning a Kirin cloaks itself with has been confirmed to toughen its skin. The key to hunting a Kirin lies in staggering it, using Elderseal weapons, and protecting yourself from and avoiding its lightning attacks.

ailments.name: Paralysis
ailments.description: Paralysis renders the hunter or monster immobilized and susceptible to increased damage for the duration. Hunters can unparalyzed if they are hit.

ailments.name: Thunderblight
ailments.description: Thunderblight increases the chance of being stunned.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Uma criatura fantasmagórica que poucos já viram. Um vislumbre desta criatura é uma imagem traumática.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Kirin é tão raramente visto que pouco é conhecido de sua ecologia. Dizem que se envolvem em pura eletricidade quando são provocados.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: O relâmpago que um Kirin se camuflam foi confirmado para endurecer sua pele. A chave para caçar um Kirin reside em esfaqueá-lo, usando armas Elderseal, e proteger-se de e evitar seus ataques relâmpagos.

entries.name: Kulve Taroth
entries.description: An Elder Dragon that protects itself with a glittering coat of metal. Its ecology and coat differ with each appearance, thus the need for a thorough investigation. An exhaustive investigation is required in order to break Kulve Taroth's giant gold plated horns. Pursue the monster to learn more about it. Gather tracks and recruit hunters to help you further your investigation.

ecology.usefulInfo: An exhaustive investigation is required in order to break Kulve Taroth's giant gold plated horns. Pursue the monster to learn more about it. Gather tracks and recruit hunters to help you further your investigation.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Dragão ancião envolvido em um manto dourado. Quebrar seus chifres requer um enorme esforço.

itemTranslations.Kulve Taroth Golden Nugget: Pepita de Ouro de Kulve Taroth
itemTranslations.Kulve Taroth Golden Nugget+: Pepita de Ouro de Kulve Taroth+

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um dragão mais velho que se protege com um casaco brilhante de metal. Sua ecologia e casaco diferem com cada aparência, assim a necessidade de uma investigação completa.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: É necessária uma investigação exaustiva a fim de quebrar os chifres banhados a ouro gigante de Kulve Taroth. Faça com que o monstro aprenda mais sobre isso. Reunir faixas e recrutar caçadores para ajudá-lo a promover a sua investigação.

entries.name: Kushala Daora
entries.description: An elder dragon that shields itself with fierce winds, preventing anyone from approaching it. Its skin consists of hard, metallic scales.

ecology.characteristics: An elder dragon that shields itself with fierce winds, preventing anyone from approaching it. Its skin consists of hard, metallic scales.
ecology.usefulInfo: When confronted by enemies, Kushala's wind shield continuously grows in intensity, eventually deflecting bow and bowgun attacks. Its wind shield can be weakened by staggering it, particularly with weapons with Elderseal capabilities.

ailments.name: Stun
ailments.description: Stun renders the target inactive, and sometimes causes them to fall over.

entries.descriptionPt: Um dragão ancião oculto por ventos fortes que impedem qualquer um de se aproximar.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um dragão mais velho que se protege com ventos ferozes, impedindo que qualquer um se aproxime dele. Sua pele consiste em balanças metálicas e duras.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Quando confrontado por inimigos, o escudo de vento de Kushala cresce continuamente em intensidade, eventualmente deflectindo ataques de arco e arco. Seu escudo de vento pode ser enfraquecido por escaloná-lo, particularmente com armas com capacidades de Elderseal.

entries.name: Lavasioth
entries.description: Lavasioth utilizes molten lava as armor. They are extremely aggressive and will attack without prejudice until the threat has been eliminated.

ecology.characteristics: Lavasioths utilize molten lava as armor. They are extremely aggressive and will attack without prejudice until the threat has been eliminated.
ecology.usefulInfo: The hardened magma on Lavasioth's body becomes softer as it swims through the lava. Attack its armor immediately after it surfaces to increase your chances of destroying it before it rehardens.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Uma hidroserpe cruel que nada em lava e usa magma endurecido como armadura.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Lavasiotos utilizam lava derretida como armadura. Eles são extremamente agressivos e vão atacar sem preconceito até que a ameaça tenha sido eliminada.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: O magma endurecido no corpo de Lavasiote torna-se mais suave enquanto nada através da lava. Ataque sua armadura imediatamente depois que ela supera para aumentar suas chances de destruí-la antes que ele se endureça.

entries.name: Legiana
entries.description: The apex monster of the Coral Highlands, whose diet primarily consists of Raphinos. It emits a chilling wind from its body, which dulls its prey's ability to escape.

ecology.characteristics: The apex monster of the Coral Highlands, whose diet primarily consists of Raphinos. It emits a chilling wind from its body, which dulls its prey's ability to escape.
ecology.usefulInfo: The membrane that covers its entire body enables Leginana to move with incredible speed. Damaging this membrane should help with slowing it down. Poison attacks have also been known to be effective.

ailments.name: Iceblight
ailments.description: Iceblight causes stamina usage to increase when performing actions.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: O senhor dos Planaltos Coralinos. Emite um vento frio do corpo para desacelerar a presa.

ecologyPt.characteristics: O monstro ápice do Planalto Coralino, cuja dieta consiste principalmente de Raphinos. Ele emite um vento arrepiante de seu corpo, que embota a capacidade de sua presa de escapar.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: A membrana que cobre todo o seu corpo permite que Leginana se mova com velocidade incrível. Danar esta membrana deve ajudar a abrandá-la. Os ataques de veneno também foram conhecidos por serem eficazes.

entries.name: Lunastra
entries.description: A rare female Elder Dragon that litters the air with hot blue dust. Reports of it traveling with her mate, Teostra, are still unconfirmed.

ecology.characteristics: A rare female elder dragon that litters the air with hot blue dust. Reports of it traveling with her mate, Teostra, are still unconfirmed.
ecology.usefulInfo: Lunastra's body temperature and dust saps away health unless you use a Cool Drink. Its dust and blue flame explode when it comes into contact with fire, so use bomb or Crystalburts.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

healthProfiles.rank: M★6 One Hot Night in the Spire

entries.descriptionPt: Um dragão ancião fêmea, com chifres em forma de coroa e pele azul. Emite calor intenso.

healthProfiles.rank: M★6 One Hot Night in the Spire

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um dragão mais velho feminino raro que acende o ar com pó azul quente. Relatórios dele viajando com seu companheiro, Teostra, ainda não estão confirmados.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: A temperatura corporal de Lunastra e a poeira saem da saúde a menos que você use um refrigerante. Sua poeira e chama azul explodem quando entra em contato com o fogo, então use bomba ou Crystalburts.

entries.name: Nergigante
entries.description: A terrible elder dragon that appears when other elders are in the vicinity. Its penchant for destruction is well documented.

ecology.characteristics: A terrible elder dragon that appears when other elders are in the vicinity. Its penchant for destruction is well-documented.
ecology.usefulInfo: Nergigante can recover from wounds almost instantaneously. Regenerated body parts grow harder over time, so attacking them while they're still fresh is the ideal strategy.

entries.descriptionPt: Um dragão ancião terrível, com um grande apetite por destruição. Não se preocupa com o próprio bem-estar.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um terrível dragão mais velho que aparece quando outros anciãos estão nas proximidades. Seu penchant para destruição é bem documentado.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Nergigante pode recuperar de feridas quase instantaneamente. As partes do corpo regeneradas tornam-se mais duras ao longo do tempo, então atacando-as enquanto ainda são frescas é a estratégia ideal.

entries.name: Odogaron
entries.description: A terrifying monster that scours the Rotten Vale for carrion. Its highly aggressive nature means that anything, be it monster or man, is a potential meal.

ecology.characteristics: A terrifying monster that scours the Rotten Vale for carrion. Its highly aggressive nature means that anything, be it monster or man, is a potential meal.
ecology.usefulInfo: Odogaron's nasty claws cause heavy bleeding and should be avoided at all costs. Use meat to lure it into traps, stagger it, or coerce it into bouts of rage to tire it out and make it easier to deal with.

ailments.name: Bleeding
ailments.description: Bleeding causes damage when performing certain actions, such as running, dodging, or attacking.

items.name: Well-done Steak
items.description: Provides a moderate boost to your stamina and keeps it at max for a longer period. Meat done right!

items.name: Astera Jerky
items.description: Juicy, dried meat made by Astera's chef. Boosts natural healing and cures bleeding.

items.name: Sushifish Scale
items.description: A scale from a Sushifish. Eat to restore a small amount of health. Also works to treat bleeding.

entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro aterrorizante que esmiúça a terra em busca de carniça para levar ao seu ninho.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um monstro aterrorizante que atira o Vale Rotten para carrion. Sua natureza altamente agressiva significa que qualquer coisa, seja monstro ou homem, é uma refeição potencial.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: As garras desagradáveis de Odogaron causam sangramento pesado e devem ser evitadas a todos os custos. Use carne para atraí-lo em armadilhas, esfaqueá-lo, ou coerce-lo em lutas de raiva para cansá-lo e torná-lo mais fácil de lidar com.

entries.name: Paolumu
entries.description: Paolumu feast on eggs found in the Coral Highlands. They are able to propel through the air using unique sacs in their bodies, and attack with their extremely hard tails.

ecology.characteristics: Paolumu feast on eggs found in the Coral Highlands. They are able to float through the air using unique sacs in their bodies, and attack with their extremely hard tails.
ecology.usefulInfo: Paolumu can't move around as freely when its air sacs are deflated. Aim for its inflated body parts, or purposefully draw out its attacks that use up stored air, to gain the upper hand.

ailments.name: Wind Pressure
ailments.description: Wind pressure causes the hunter to brace against powerful winds, causing temporarily imobility.

entries.descriptionPt: Gosta de fazer um lanche com os ovos dos Planaltos Coralinos. Libera o ar do corpo para se mover rapidamente.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Festa de Paolumu em ovos encontrados nas Terras Altas Coral. Eles são capazes de flutuar através do ar usando sacos únicos em seus corpos, e atacar com suas caudas extremamente duras.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Paolumu não pode se mover livremente quando seus sacos de ar são deflacionados. Apontar para suas partes infladas do corpo, ou propositadamente desenhar seus ataques que usam o ar armazenado, para ganhar a mão superior.

entries.name: Radobaan
entries.description: A gigantic brute wyvern that eats the bones of carcasses found in the Rotten Vale, using some of it as armor. It also rolls into a ball as a form of attack and transportation.

ecology.characteristics: A gigantic brute wyvern that eats the bones of carcasses found in the Rotten Vale, using some of it as armor. It also rolls into a ball as a form of attack and transportation.
ecology.usefulInfo: Attack it as it rolls around to throw it off balance and knock it down. Chunks of bone can be mined from its body once it's down. Shattering its bone armor is the key to winning a fight against this beast.

ailments.name: Sleep
ailments.description: Sleep renders the hunter or monster inactive and susceptible to increased damage, but only for the first hit, as it will then wake them up.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.description: A Guild-approved beverage that boosts your stamina. Helps shake off sleep, too!

entries.descriptionPt: Uma serpe bruta envolta em uma armadura de ossos. Ela se enrola em uma bola para se mover e atacar.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma gigantesca wyvern que come os ossos das carcaças encontradas no Vale Rotten, usando alguns como armadura. Ele também rola em uma bola como uma forma de ataque e transporte.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Atacá-lo enquanto rola para jogá-lo fora do equilíbrio e derrubá-lo. Os pedaços de osso podem ser extraídos do seu corpo assim que estiver em baixo. Partir sua armadura óssea é a chave para ganhar uma luta contra esta besta.

entries.name: Rathalos
entries.description: The apex monster of the Ancient Forest, also known as the "King of the Skies". A fierce wyvern that descends upon invaders, attacking with its venomous claws and fiery breath.

ecology.characteristics: The apex monster of the Ancient Forest, also known as the "King of the Skies". A terrible wyvern that descends upon invaders, attacking with poison claws and fiery breath.
ecology.usefulInfo: Rathalos prefer to stay airborner to unleash their myriad attacks, but a well-placed flash bomb or a shot from your slinger can send them crashing to the earth. Wounding their wings gives them a moment of vulnerability whenever they try to take flight.

healthProfiles.rank: ★1 Fungal Flexin' in the Ancient Forest

entries.descriptionPt: O predador máximo da Floresta Ancestral patrulha os céus, sempre em busca de intrusos.

healthProfiles.rank: ★1 Fungal Flexin' in the Ancient Forest

ecologyPt.characteristics: O monstro ápice da Floresta Antiga, também conhecido como o "Rei dos Esquis". Uma terrível wyvern que desce sobre invasores, atacando com garras venenosas e ardente.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Rathalos preferem manter-se porta-aviões para libertar seus ataques miríades, mas uma Bomba de Clarão bem colocada ou um tiro de seu slinger pode enviá-los para a terra. Ferir as asas dá-lhes um momento de vulnerabilidade sempre que tentam voar.

entries.name: Rathian
entries.description: A wyvern known as the "Queen of the Land." Terrestrial predator, it overpowers its prey with a venomous tail and powerful legs.

ecology.characteristics: Wyverns known as the "Queens of the Land". Terrestrial predators, they overpowered prey with their venomous tails and powerful legs.
ecology.usefulInfo: Come prepared with fire-resistant armor, and neuter its poison attacks by severing its tail. Be careful when stealing an egg from its nest, for a Rathian will chase an egg thief to the ends of the New World.

entries.descriptionPt: A rainha da terra, armada com chutes poderosos e um veneno letal.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Wyverns conhecido como "Queens of the Land". Predadores terrestres, eles dominavam a presa com suas caudas venenosas e pernas poderosas.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Venha preparado com armadura resistente ao fogo, e neuter seus ataques de veneno cortando sua cauda. Tenha cuidado ao roubar um ovo de seu ninho, pois um Rathian perseguirá um ladrão de ovos até os confins do Novo Mundo.

entries.name: Pink Rathian
entries.description: A subspecies with vibrant pink scales. Pink Rathians wield their toxic tails more deftly than normal Rathians, weakening prey with poison before moving in for the kill.

ecology.characteristics: A subspecies with vibrant pink scales. Pink Rathians wield their toxic tails more deftly than normal Rathians, weakening prey with poison before moving in for the kill.
ecology.usefulInfo: Pink Rathians develop hard shells on different body parts compared to standard Rathians, particularly on their tails. If you're looking to sever its tail, aim for the relatively soft tip of the tail.

healthProfiles.rank: ★7 Old World Monster in the New World

entries.descriptionPt: Uma Rathian coberta de escamas brilhantes. Prefere atacar com sua cauda venenosa.

healthProfiles.rank: ★7 Old World Monster in the New World

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma subespécie com escalas rosa vibrantes. Os Rathian cor-de-rosa manejaram suas caudas tóxicas mais deftly do que os Rathian normais, enfraquecendo a presa com o veneno antes de se mover para a morte.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Rathian rosa desenvolver conchas duras em diferentes partes do corpo em comparação com Rathian padrão, particularmente em suas caudas. Se você está procurando cortar sua cauda, aponte para a ponta relativamente macia da cauda.

entries.name: Teostra
entries.description: A brutal elder dragon wreathed in flames that spits blazing fire. Teostra are of such a fierce and deadly nature that the Guild closely monitors their movements.

ecology.characteristics: Brutal elder dragons wreathed in flames that spit blazing fire. Teostra are of such a fierce and deadly nature that the Guild closely monitors their movements.
ecology.usefulInfo: The black scale dust Teostra scatters will spread over a wide area until it finally explodes. Keep an eye on that, as well as the flames it occasionally shields itself in, and aim to stagger it with weapons possessing Elderseal capabilities.

ailments.name: Blastblight
ailments.description: Blastblight will cause a damaging explosion after a certain amount of time has passed, or upon sustaining a heavy impact.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Um dragão ancião envolto em chamas. O ranger de suas presas afiadas pode detonar suas escamas dispersas.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Dragões de anciãos brutais ferveram em chamas que cuspir fogo ardente. Teostra são de natureza tão feroz e mortal que a Guild monitora de perto seus movimentos.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Os dispersos Teostra de poeira de escala preta espalhar-se-ão por uma área ampla até que finalmente explode. Fique de olho nisso, bem como as chamas em que ocasionalmente se protege, e tem como objetivo esfaqueá-lo com armas que possuem capacidades de Elderseal.

entries.name: Tzitzi-Ya-Ku
entries.description: This odd monster blinds both prey and enemies with a special pulsing organ near its head. It then uses its strong legs to deliver finishing blows.

ecology.characteristics: This odd monster blinds both prey and enemies with a special pulsing organ near its head. It then uses its strong legs to deliver finishing blows.
ecology.usefulInfo: Tzizi-Ya-Ku's organs begin to radiate before it releases its blinding pulse, giving you enough time to escape and flank it. Damaging this organ will dramatically decrease the flash's effective range.

ailments.name: Stun
ailments.description: Stun renders the target inactive, and sometimes causes them to fall over.

entries.descriptionPt: Cega a presa e os inimigos com um órgão especial pulsante na cabeça.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Este monstro estranho cega tanto presa e inimigos com um órgão pulsante especial perto de sua cabeça. Ele então usa suas pernas fortes para entregar golpes de acabamento.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Os órgãos de Tzizi-Ya-Ku começam a irradiar antes de liberar seu pulso de blindagem, dando-lhe tempo suficiente para escapar e flanqueá-lo. Danar este órgão irá diminuir drasticamente a gama eficaz do flash.

entries.name: Uragaan
entries.description: Large Brute Wyverns that feed on ore, using their mighty jaws to crush solid rock to powder. They've been known to confront Lavasioths over territory disputes.

ecology.characteristics: Large brute wyverns that feed on ore, using their mighty to crush solid rock to powder. They've been known to confront Lavasioths over territory disputes.
ecology.usefulInfo: A crushing slam from the Uragaan's jaw can send shockwaves across the ground, detonating any explosive rocks in the area. In addition, when an Uragaan is toppled, its body can be mined for ore.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

ailments.name: Sleep
ailments.description: Sleep renders the hunter or monster inactive and susceptible to increased damage, but only for the first hit, as it will then wake them up.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.description: A Guild-approved beverage that boosts your stamina. Helps shake off sleep, too!

entries.descriptionPt: Um monstro que usa sua mandíbula enorme para esmagar minério e consumi-lo.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Grandes cavernas brutas que se alimentam de minério, usando seus poderosos para esmagar rocha sólida em pó. Eles foram conhecidos por confrontar Lavasiotes sobre disputas territoriais.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Um slam esmagador da mandíbula de Uragaan pode enviar ondas de choque através do chão, detonando quaisquer rochas explosivas na área. Além disso, quando um Uragaan é derrubado, seu corpo pode ser extraído para minério.

entries.name: Vaal Hazak
entries.description: A grotesque Elder Dragon, that inhabits the deepest part of the Rotten Vale. It uses the fatal vapor of the vale in what appears to be a symbiotic relationship.

ecology.characteristics: A grotesque elder dragon that inhabits the deepest part of the Rotten Vale. It uses the fatal vapor of the vale in what appears to be a symbiotic relationship.
ecology.usefulInfo: Once you've become tainted, inhaling the vapor of the vale causes your own health to drain. Head for areas there the vapor is thin, and if you do get tainted, do your best to get rid of it.

ailments.name: Effluvial Buildup
ailments.description: Effluvial buildup causes damage over time, and eventually cuts your maximum health in half if ignored for too long.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

skills.name: Effluvial Expert
skills.description: Nullifies or reduces environmental damage in the Rotten Vale.

skills.name: Effluvia Resistance
skills.description: Gain a resistance to effluvial buildup.

entries.descriptionPt: Um dragão ancião temível que vive no eflúvio. Caso o vapor se dissipe, o dragão acumulará mais.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um dragão grotesco que habita a parte mais profunda do Vale Rotten. Usa o vapor fatal do vale no que parece ser uma relação simbiótica.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Uma vez que você se tornou contaminado, inalando o vapor do vale faz com que sua própria saúde drenar. Cabeça para áreas lá o vapor é fino, e se você ficar contaminado, fazer o seu melhor para se livrar dele.

entries.name: Xeno'jiiva
entries.description: RESEARCHING. Threat level unknown.

ecology.characteristics: A new species discovered in the depths of the Elders's Recess. Its relationship to the other elder dragons is unclear, as is its ecology.
ecology.usefulInfo: Perhaps as a result of its inability to fully control its own incalculable power, Xeno'jiiva is prone to go into a rampage when its energy-filled limbs take enough damage. Endure its rampage and you may be rewarded with a good opening for attack.

ailments.name: Dragonblight
ailments.description: Dragonblight causes your weapon's elemental properties are nullified.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Nenhuma informação disponível.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma nova espécie descoberta nas profundezas do Recess dos Anciãos. Sua relação com os outros dragões mais velhos não é clara, como é sua ecologia.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Talvez, como resultado de sua incapacidade de controlar totalmente seu próprio poder incalculável, Xeno'jiiva é propenso a entrar em um desenfreamento quando seus membros cheios de energia tomam danos suficientes. Endurecer seu desenfreado e você pode ser recompensado com uma boa abertura para o ataque.

entries.name: Zorah Magdaros
entries.description: An elder dragon that rises from the earth like a volcano. Where it's headed, and why, the Research Commission has yet to figure out.

ecology.characteristics: An elder dragon that rises from the earth like a volcano. Where it's headed, and why, the Research Commision has yet figure out.
ecology.usefulInfo: Normal attacks can't make a dent in its mountain-like shell. Utilize larger weapons such as cannons and ballistae, or directly attack the "Magmacore" heat organs that are exposed in parts of its outer shell.

ailments.name: Fireblight
ailments.description: Fireblight causes damage over time, and negates regular health recovery.

items.name: Nulberry
items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Um dragão ancião com um casco tão enorme e alto que chega a ser confundido com um vulcão.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um dragão mais velho que nasce da terra como um vulcão. Para onde vai, e porquê, a Comissão de Pesquisa ainda descobriu.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Os ataques normais não podem fazer um dent em sua casca de montanha. Utilizar armas maiores, como canhões e balistas, ou atacar diretamente os órgãos de calor "Magmacore" que são expostos em partes de sua concha exterior.

entries.name: Leshen
entries.description: Dwelling deep inside the forest, these creatures use their innate magic to control all flora and fauna within their territory.

ecology.characteristics: Dwelling deep inside the forest, these creatures use their innate magic to control all flora and fauna within their territory.
ecology.usefulInfo: Revoltures and Jagras controlled by a leshen are tough to approach, but the Igni Sign very useful in fending off the leshens's lashing roots.

healthProfiles.rank: ★9 Contract: Trouble in the Ancient Forest

entries.descriptionPt: Criatura de outro mundo que vive em florestas primitivas. Controla a fauna e a flora de seu território.

healthProfiles.rank: ★9 Contract: Trouble in the Ancient Forest

ecologyPt.characteristics: Mergulhando profundamente dentro da floresta, essas criaturas usam sua magia inata para controlar toda a flora e fauna dentro de seu território.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: As revoltas e os Jagras controlados por um leshen são difíceis de se aproximar, mas o Sinal Igni muito útil em afastar as raízes do leshens.

entries.name: Ancient Leshen
entries.description: An old leshen that arrived through a portal to assume control over the Ancient Forest. Sometimes revered as an indigenous deity.

ecology.characteristics: An old leshen that arrived through a portal to assume control over the Ancient Forest. Sometimes revered as an indigenous deity.
ecology.usefulInfo: Ancient Leshens use their wisdom and tactical knowledge to curse hunters and send packs of wild Jagras after them.

entries.descriptionPt: Criatura tão antiga e poderosa que às vezes é adorada como divindade local no mundo de onde veio.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um velho leshen que chegou através de um portal para assumir o controle sobre a Floresta Antiga. Às vezes reverenciado como uma divindade indígena.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Os antigos Leshens usam sua sabedoria e conhecimento tático para amaldiçoar caçadores e enviar pacotes de Jagras selvagens depois deles.

entries.name: Safi'jiiva
entries.description: The fully-grown form of Xeno'jiiva. It absorbs energy from its environment to heal itself and change the ecosystem.

ecology.characteristics: The fully-grown form of Xeno'jiiva. It absorbs energy from its environment to heal itself and change the ecosystem.
ecology.usefulInfo: Its breath can be avoided by hiding behind obstacles. Drain its energy by breaking its parts and using the environment. Once it's cornered, work together to take it down.

ecologyPt.characteristics: A forma totalmente crescida de Xeno'jiiva. Absorve a energia do seu ambiente para se curar e mudar o ecossistema.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Sua respiração pode ser evitada escondendo-se atrás de obstáculos. Drenar sua energia quebrando suas partes e usando o ambiente. Uma vez encurralado, trabalhem juntos para o derrubar.

entries.name: Stygian Zinogre
entries.description: Has a symbiotic relationship with Dracophage Bugs, which it releases like bullets. Becomes even more dangerous when covered in light.

ecology.characteristics: Has a symbiotic relationship with Dracophage Bugs, which it releases like bullets. Becomes even more dangerous when covered in light.
ecology.usefulInfo: Its powered-up state is cancelled when it flinches or is toppled. When its hide toughens, it becomes more vulnerable to elemental attacks.

entries.descriptionPt: Tem uma relação simbiótica com Insetos Dragofágicos, que lança como projéteis. Muito perigoso.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Tem uma relação simbiótica com Bugs Dracophage, que libera como balas. Torna-se ainda mais perigoso quando coberto de luz.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Seu estado powered-up é cancelado quando ele flinches ou é derrubado. Quando sua pele endurece, torna-se mais vulnerável a ataques elementares.

entries.name: Rajang
entries.description: An ultra-aggressive creature that few have a chance of surviving against. Sports powerful arms that pack a punch, and turns gold when angry.

ecology.characteristics: An ultra-aggressive creature that few have a chance of surviving against. Sports powerful arms that pack a punch. Turns gold when angry.
ecology.usefulInfo: Rajang is most dangerous when its arms are powered up, and can even destroy shock traps. Pitfall traps are effective, but only when it's enraged. Will immediately attack anything that invades its territory.

ailments.name: Thunderblight
ailments.description: Thunderblight increases the chance of being stunned.

items.description: A mysterious berry that cures various blights.

entries.descriptionPt: Territorial e superagressivo. Destrói armadilhas de choque quando enfurecido. Ataque a cauda para deter a fúria.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma criatura ultra-agressiva que poucos têm hipótese de sobreviver. Esportes braços poderosos que embalam um soco. Vira ouro quando zangado.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Rajang é mais perigoso quando seus braços são alimentados, e pode até destruir armadilhas de choque. As armadilhas são eficazes, mas só quando está enfurecido. Imediatamente atacará qualquer coisa que invade seu território.

entries.name: Viper Tobi-Kadachi
entries.description: The tail of this subspecies secretes a toxin while its fangs paralyze prey. It can also glide without climbing trees.

ecology.characteristics: The tail of this subspecies secretes a toxin while its fangs paralyze prey. It can also glide without climbing trees.
ecology.usefulInfo: Its agility is its greatest weapon, but also makes it prone to exhaustion. When tired, it grows drastically less mobile. Focus attacks on its soft parts to tucker it out quickly.

ailments.name: Paralysis
ailments.description: Paralysis renders the hunter or monster immobilized and susceptible to increased damage for the duration. Hunters can unparalyzed if they are hit.

ailments.name: Poison
ailments.description: Poison slowly drains the target's health.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: A cure for poison.

items.name: Herbal Medicine
items.description: Removes all traces of poison and restores a slight amount of health.

entries.descriptionPt: Sua cauda produz uma toxina, e sua mordida pode paralisar. Consegue planar sem escalar árvores.

ecologyPt.characteristics: A cauda desta subespécie secreta uma toxina enquanto suas presas paralisam presas. Também pode deslizar sem escalar árvores.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Sua agilidade é sua maior arma, mas também a torna propensa à exaustão. Quando cansado, cresce drasticamente menos móvel. Concentre-se em ataques em suas partes macias para despistar rapidamente.

entries.name: Namielle
entries.description: An Elder Dragon said to be able to command water and use it as a shield. Though very few sightings have ever been reported, they mention 'exploding water' and 'bright glowing lights.' Its existence remains shrouded in mystery.

ecology.characteristics: An elder dragon coated in water and able to freely control lightning. A unique organ allows it to pump electricity into the pools of water it create, causing massive bursts of steam.
ecology.usefulInfo: Emitting water cause its coating to decrease, and it becomes vulnerable when dry. Use brightmoss and other slinger fire to remove any nearby sources of water.

entries.descriptionPt: Um dragão ancião coberto de água. Capaz de gerar eletricidade no corpo e lançá-la contra inimigos.

healthProfiles.rank: M★5 A Light From The Abyss

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um dragão mais velho revestido em água e capaz de controlar livremente o raio. Um órgão único permite bombear eletricidade nas piscinas de água que cria, causando enormes explosões de vapor.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Emitir água faz com que seu revestimento diminua, e torna-se vulnerável quando seco. Use fogo mais brilhante e outro slinger para remover quaisquer fontes próximas de água.

entries.name: Zinogre
entries.description: Lightning courses through the fur and unique plating of this fanged wyvern. It is most deadly in its supercharged state.

ecology.characteristics: Lightning courses through the fur and unique plating of this fanged wyvern. It is most deadly in its Supercharged state.
ecology.usefulInfo: When Supercharged, parts of the monster become soft, but shock traps no longer work. You can also knock it out of Supercharged mode by making it flinch several times. Once it's down, you can use the capture net to collect materials.

ailments.name: Thunderblight
ailments.description: Thunderblight increases the chance of being stunned.

entries.descriptionPt: Eletricidade corre no pelo desta serpe de presas. Fica ainda mais letal quando supercarregada.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Cursos de clareamento através da pele e chapeamento único desta wyvern com presas. É mais mortal em seu estado Supercharged.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Quando Supercharged, partes do monstro se tornam macias, mas as armadilhas de choque não funcionam mais. Você também pode tirá-lo do modo Supercharged, tornando-o flinch várias vezes. Depois de descer, você pode usar a rede de captura para coletar materiais.

entries.name: Ebony Odogaron
entries.description: This Odogaron subspecies is forever on the prowl for its next meal, and is often seen carrying fresh kills in its mouth. Reports indicate it goes into a frenzy upon eating.

ecology.characteristics: This Odogaron subspecies is forever on the prowl for its next meal, and is often seen carrying fresh kills in its mouth. Reports indicate it goes into a frenzy upon eating.
ecology.usefulInfo: When frenzied, it uses dragon elemental attack, but hunters can hit its head with their own elemental attack to calm it. The key to success is to keep it from feeding.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Esta subespécie de Odogaron está para sempre na proa para sua próxima refeição, e é muitas vezes visto carregando matanças frescas em sua boca. Os relatórios indicam que entra em um frenesi ao comer.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Quando frenzied, ele usa ataque elemental dragão, mas os caçadores podem bater sua cabeça com seu próprio ataque elemental para acalmá-lo. A chave para o sucesso é evitar a alimentação.

entries.name: Banbaro
entries.description: A monster with two giant horns, like a running brick wall. It charges at threats while digging its massive horns in the ground, sometimes picking up entire trees along the way.

ecology.characteristics: A monster marked by its furious charge and by the majestic twin horns that uproot trees and gouge at the earth as it runs.
ecology.usefulInfo: Blows to the Banbaro's legs are an effective counter to its deadly charge. Hunters have also reported that firing scatternuts or crystalburst mid-charge can halt the beast.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um monstro marcado por sua carga furiosa e pelos majestosos chifres gêmeos que arrancam árvores e gouge na terra enquanto corre.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Os sopros nas pernas do Banbaro são um contador eficaz para a sua carga mortal. Os caçadores também relataram que o fogo de lanças ou o meio-carga de cristal podem parar a besta.

entries.name: Beotodus
entries.description: A piscine wyvern that uses the sharp fin on its head to cut through the frozen soil, swimming freely through the snow. Can often be seen hurling snow at its prey using its leg fins.

ecology.characteristics: This piscine monster's wedge-shaped head allows it to freely swim through the tundra snow. Frequently seen flinging snow at prey.
ecology.usefulInfo: Stripping the snow packed on its body will force the monster out into the open. Firing screamer pods can provide an opening to attack: focus on its legs fins to weaken it.

entries.descriptionPt: A cabeça pontuda desse monstro permite que ele nade livremente pela neve da tundra.

ecologyPt.characteristics: A cabeça em forma de cunha deste monstro piscine permite-lhe nadar livremente pela neve de tundra. Frequentemente visto fling neve na presa.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Rasgar a neve embalada em seu corpo vai forçar o monstro para fora em aberto. Pulando cápsulas de gritador pode fornecer uma abertura para atacar: foco em suas pernas barbatanas para enfraquecê-lo.

entries.name: Nargacuga
entries.description: A flying wyvern covered in pitch black fur. It is extremely agile, especially on the ground, moving with explosive bursts of speed.

ecology.characteristics: Extremely agile, especially on the ground, this obsidian-furred flying wyvern moves with explosive burst of speed.
ecology.usefulInfo: Nargacuga's speed dulls when exhausted, so luring it into turf wars with other monsters is effective. Take care when setting traps, as it will destroy pitfalls when not enraged.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Extremamente ágil, especialmente no chão, este wyvern voador obsidiano move-se com explosão explosiva de velocidade.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: A velocidade de Nargacuga diminui quando exausto, então luring-lo em guerras de relva com outros monstros é eficaz. Tome cuidado ao definir armadilhas, pois destruirá armadilhas quando não enfurecido.

entries.name: Velkhana
entries.description: An elder dragon with the power to freeze all in its path. According to legend, it can control the cold, and use its freezing breath to conjure massive spires of ice out of nowhere.

ecology.characteristics: An elder dragon said to freeze all in its path. According to legend, it can control the cold, and use its freezing breath to conjure massive spires of ice out of nowhere.
ecology.usefulInfo: Shattering the ice that encases its body neutralizes its freezing breath. The ice walls it forms can be broken to provide platforms for mounting. Torch Pods are useful for this.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Um dragão mais velho disse para congelar tudo em seu caminho. De acordo com a lenda, ele pode controlar o frio, e usar sua respiração gelada para conjurar enormes spires de gelo do nada.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Partilhar o gelo que envolve seu corpo neutraliza sua respiração gelada. As paredes de gelo que forma podem ser quebradas para fornecer plataformas para a montagem. Torch Pods são úteis para isso.

entries.name: Tigrex
entries.description: A flying wyvern straight out of prehistory, known for its deafening roar and powerful legs that drive its overwhelming charge.

ecology.characteristics: A flying wyvern straight out of prehistory, known for its deafening roar and powerful legs that drive its overwhelming charge.
ecology.usefulInfo: Ledges and obstacles won't stop Tigrex's charge, so you'll need to steer clear. After enough repetitions the monster will tire and slow down, opening up to counterattacks.

entries.descriptionPt: Uma serpe alada pré-histórica. Tem um rugido ensurdecedor e uma investida esmagadora.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma wyvern voadora diretamente fora da pré-história, conhecida por suas pernas rugas e poderosas que impulsionam sua carga esmagadora.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Conduzidos e obstáculos não pararão a carga de Tigrex, então você terá que dirigir clara. Depois de repetições suficientes, o monstro vai se cansar e abrandar, abrindo para contra-ataques.

entries.name: Shrieking Legiana
entries.description: A Legiana variant shrouded in white frost. It specializes in freezing prey with the powerful chill it emits, then swooping down to strike at them from overhead.

ecology.characteristics: A Legiana variant shrouded in white frost. It specializes in freezing prey with the powerful chill it emits, then swooping down to strike at them from overhead.
ecology.usefulInfo: Sufficient damage can knock it out of the sky, and it is especially vulnerable while dive-bombing, making barrel bombs effective. Like other Legiana, poison also works well.

entries.descriptionPt: O corpo dessa variante de Legiana é coberto de gelo. Ataca mergulhando e usando vento gelado.

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma variante Legiana envolta em geada branca. É especializada em congelar presa com o poderoso resfriado emite, em seguida, deslizando para baixo para atacar-los de sobrecarga.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Dano suficiente pode derrubá-lo do céu, e é especialmente vulnerável ao mergulhar-bombing, tornando as bombas de barril eficazes. Como outra Legiana, o veneno também funciona bem.

entries.name: Barioth
entries.description: he snow-white flying wyvern with huge tusks found in the frozen tundra. It uses its forelegs and tail to traverse ice with ease.

ecology.characteristics: The snow-white flying wyvern huge tusks found in the frozen tundra. It uses its forelegs and tail to traverse ice with ease.
ecology.usefulInfo: Break its tail, or especially its forelegs to mitigate both its offense and its mobility. The monster's hide is extremely tough, but fire elemental attacks should prove effective.

entries.descriptionPt: Uma serpe alada branca que habita a tundra. Usa as asas e a cauda para locomover-se facilmente pelo gelo.

ecologyPt.characteristics: As enormes presas voadoras brancas de neve encontradas na tundra congelada. Ele usa suas pernas e cauda para atravessar o gelo com facilidade.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Partir sua cauda, ou especialmente seus antepassados para mitigar tanto sua ofensa quanto sua mobilidade. A pele do monstro é extremamente dura, mas os ataques elementares de fogo devem ser eficazes.

entries.name: Glavenus
entries.description: A brute wyvern that wields its heavy blue tail like a blade. It grows hotter and more keen with each strike until it glows red.

ecology.characteristics: A brute wyvern that wields its heavy, blue tail like a blade. It grows hotter and more keen with each strike until it glows red.
ecology.usefulInfo: Once red hot, its tail will begin to rust and the monster will sharpen it anew with its fangs, storing the slag to expel as fiery breath. Strike its throat when it glows red.

healthProfiles.rank: M★2 A Face Nightmares Are Made Of

ecologyPt.characteristics: Uma wyvern brute que limpa sua cauda pesada, azul como uma lâmina. Cresce mais quente e mais aguçado com cada greve até brilhar vermelho.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Uma vez vermelho quente, sua cauda começará a ferrugem e o monstro irá afiá-lo de novo com suas presas, armazenando a escória para expulsar como respiração ardente. Ataca a garganta quando brilha vermelho.

entries.name: Brachydios
entries.description: This marine-blue brute wyvern uses its saliva to prime the sticky slime coating its massive arms, rendering it highly explosive.

ecology.characteristics: This marine-blue brute wyvern uses its saliva to prime the sticky slime coating its massive arms, rendering it highly explosive.
ecology.usefulInfo: Its scalp secretes a thick slime capable of tripping hunters who step in it. Water will dilute it, however, making water and ice attack to its head and arms effective.

ailments.name: Blastscourge
ailments.description: goes terribly kaboom

healthProfiles.rank: M★1 Can't Bring Yourself To It

entries.descriptionPt: Esta serpe bruta lambe o lodo que cobre seus braços para deixá-lo altamente explosivo.

healthProfiles.rank: M★1 Can't Bring Yourself To It

ecologyPt.characteristics: Esta wyvern azul-marinho usa sua saliva para primer o emagrecimento pegajoso revestimento seus braços maciços, tornando-o altamente explosivo.
ecologyPt.usefulInfo: Seu couro cabeludo secreta um lodo grosso capaz de tropeçar caçadores que pisam nele. A água irá diluí-la, no entanto, fazendo com que a água e o gelo ataquem à sua cabeça e braços eficazes.

entries.name: Fulgur Anjanath
entries.description: With every attack, this Anjanath subspecies fortifies itself with electricity that it charges within its jaws and dorsal membrane.

ecology.characteristics: Feared as the "Thunderjaw Wyvern", this Anjanath subspecies electrifies its jaws and dorsal membrane with every blow.
ecology.usefulInfo: Once it enters an electrified state, its hide hardens, and its attacks deal elemental damage. Focus blows on its head to dissipate the charge. Also note its board territory.

ailments.description: Thunderblight increases the chance of being stunned.
